name: clone
long:
git clone <repository-url> clones a git repository from a remote URL.
It creates a new directory with a copy of the repository.

name: create a branch
long:
git checkout -b <branch-name> creates a new branch named <branch-name>
and switches your working copy to that branch.

name: make a change
short: Make a change in the PR branch
command: echo "Do not modify anything in this repository" > README.md

name: add the change
short: Add the change to the staging area
long: git add README.md adds the file to the staging area

name: commit to branch
short: Commit the change to the branch
long:
git commit -m "Add feature file" records the staged changes
into the repository
command: git commit -m "Commit changes to PR branch"

name: checkout main
long: git checkout main switches your working copy back to the main branch

name: merge branch
short: Merge the PR branch into main
long:
git merge PR/BUG_123 integrates the PR branch's commits into main.
If there are conflicts, Git will prompt you to resolve them.

name: log - graph
short: Show the commit history with a graph
long:
git log --oneline --graph --decorate --all displays a compact
graph of commit history across branches.

name: delete branch
long: git branch -d PR/BUG_123 removes the PR branch from the repository locally
